title: at least one item should have a parseable pubDate

spec.name: RSS 2.0
spec.normative_quote: <pubDate> is an optional sub-element of <item>.... Its value is a date, indicating when the item was published.
spec.note: RSS makes pubDate optional. This warning is local policy because freshness cannot be evaluated without one parseable item date.

applicability: A parsed RSS channel with at least one item.
expectation: At least one item's pubDate parses as a valid date.

cases.name: the only item's pubDate does not parse
